args.reason: One column per month (spend_jan to spend_dec) holds the same measure; as rows, one per customer and month, it can be used like an order history.

text: This sheet has one row per customer (1,500) and one column per month, spend_jan to spend_dec, plus active. I asked to turn the twelve month columns into rows, one per customer and month, so they read like an order history. The months carry no year, so I did not guess one: please answer which year they are from. Nothing is applied until you approve.

Thanks, the months are now rows for 2023. The Customer Spend goal learns from the amount a customer spent in the 90 days after a snapshot date, and this sheet has no such column. The plan still asks you for it, and I have not worked it out from the months because that would be a guess about which months count. Nothing is applied until you approve.
